payload.posture: Read Acts 5:12–16 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states many signs occur through the apostles, believers gather in Solomon’s porch, people are added, and the sick and tormented are brought from neighboring cities. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
